A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same survey, with readable text, equations, tables, figures, and complete bibliographies. Sections 1–9 correspond directly. Neither PDF contains separate appendices, and no material gaps prevent comparison.

before.justification: Although primarily a literature survey, v3 reports a March 2025 test in Figure 4: DeepSeek-R1 and QwQ-32B answer a decimal-comparison question, with response lengths and elapsed times reported. This constitutes an original empirical demonstration.

after.justification: v4 retains the tested Figure 4 example, including model responses, word counts, and elapsed times. These retained original observations qualify independently of the results summarized from cited studies.

M1.justification: The method descriptions and procedures in Sections 3–6 remain substantively unchanged. Additional method names in Figure 3 catalog other studies; they do not introduce or modify an algorithm proposed by this survey.

E1.justification: The Figure 4 decimal-comparison scenario and identified datasets in the retained survey tables and benchmark discussion are unchanged. Additional literature entries do not establish additional training or evaluation coverage.

E2.justification: Figure 4 retains DeepSeek-R1 and QwQ-32B, and the corresponding tables retain their method and baseline membership. Newly cited methods in the taxonomy are not added participants in reported empirical comparisons.

E3.justification: For the surveyed DAST experiment, Table 1 changes the reported smaller model from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-8B to DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B, retaining the 32B model. This is a limited reported configuration revision; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: The overthinking demonstration and the substantive accounts of reasoning-length, compression, and failure analyses are retained. No new ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or case study is presented.

E5.justification: Neither version adds or revises repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or uncertainty-estimation procedures. Figure 4 retains the same timing and word-count reporting without uncertainty estimates.

E6.justification: Figure 4 retains DeepSeek-R1's 602 words and 42 seconds and QwQ-32B's 616 words and 19 seconds. The other substantive quantitative and qualitative findings are unchanged; the expanded taxonomy supplies no additional performance results.

T1.justification: The reward and optimization formulas in Tables 1–2, CoT-Valve parameter interpolation, and discussion of looped transformers retain the same mathematics. No substantive definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the first-structured-survey claim, the same three principal categories, and the supporting coverage of data efficiency, smaller models, benchmarking, and applications. Expanded citations do not redefine these contributions.

C2.justification: The interpretations of overthinking, efficiency tradeoffs, safety, and RL versus SFT remain unchanged, as does the qualification that OpenAI o1's mechanism is unconfirmed. Consolidating the Bag of Tricks discussion retains its existing budget-based interpretation.

D1.justification: Table 1 revises DAST's documented base-model identifier from the 8B to the 7B variant. Section 7 also drops the explicit six-method/eight-task description when consolidating Bag of Tricks. The project access link and other implementation disclosures remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Figure 3 substantially expands literature coverage across RL, SFT, latent reasoning, dynamic inference, prompting, and routing, adding studies such as ConciseRL, AutoL2S, SEAL, and ThinkSwitcher. The bibliography grows from 154 to 250 entries after duplicate consolidation. Section 2.2 also replaces an inappropriate O1-Pruner citation for OpenAI o1 with OpenAI's reasoning report.

P1.justification: The nine-section structure and most prose are retained. Changes include adding Na Zou and the University of Houston affiliation, small wording and heading edits, and consolidating duplicate references and the repeated Bag of Tricks discussion.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is reflowed with smaller, denser text and resized boxes to accommodate additional studies while retaining its branches and visual scheme. The title block and page breaks also change. Other figures and table structures remain essentially unchanged.

improvement.justification: The expanded categorized literature index makes v4 a more useful survey resource, while the corrected OpenAI o1 attribution and consolidated duplicate material improve editorial accuracy. Most additions receive only brief taxonomy entries, and Figure 3 becomes denser, so the overall benefit is limited despite the substantial increase in literature coverage.
